prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency for all situations — the right agency depends on your goals, industry, budget, timeline and whether you need digital, branding, PR, B2B, B2C, or full-service marketing.

A faster way I can help: tell me a few details and I’ll shortlist Maryland agencies that fit your needs and explain why to pick them. Useful details:
- What services do you need? (SEO, PPC, social, email, branding, content, PR, web design, etc.)
- Industry and target audience (B2B, B2C, healthcare, tech, nonprofit…)
- Company size / annual revenue and monthly marketing budget range
- Location preference (Baltimore, Annapolis, DC‑metro, statewide, remote OK)
- Key goals and KPIs (leads, sales, traffic, brand awareness, fundraising)
- Timeline (ongoing, 3–6 months, campaign-based)

If you’d like to start researching on your own, check agency listings and reviews on:
- Clutch.co
- The Manifest
- UpCity
- Google Business/Profile and Yelp
- Local awards (Baltimore Business Journal, Maryland Tech Council, Ad Age lists)

Quick checklist to evaluate agencies:
- Relevant case studies and measurable results
- Client list, references, and retention rate
- Clear scope, deliverables and reporting cadence
- Team experience with your industry and tactics
- Pricing model and contract flexibility
- Cultural fit and communication style

Tell me the details above and I’ll return a short, ranked shortlist of Maryland agencies matched to your needs (3–6 with pros/cons and next steps).
